notes.title: FORCED v1.3 - Slightly Better Edition
notes.content:
[img=http://forcedthegame.com/linkedimages/SBE_UpdateImage.png][/img]

Hi everyone!

It’s been a long time since we updated FORCED because we’ve been exceedingly busy getting the game out on consoles.
Today, however, we’ve got a real treat for you; the Slightly Better Edition.
This update upgrades the Survival modes with 2 new maps and a crystal system, allowing you to gain new powers through playing Survival.

It also contains a lot of optimization and some bug-fixing, which should help everyone run it a little smoother :)

We’re deploying this version as a patch so it’ll be freely available to everyone, and all our new gladiators will get to join in the fun right away :)

I hope you’ll pick up the game again and give it a spin, and perhaps welcome our newest members of the community who are searching for games :)
[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
[list]

[*]Gem system for survival modes: You can now earn up to 3 gems in each of the co-op survival modes, based on how long you stay alive. These gems also unlock skills in the campaign.
[*]The Laser Pit survival mode added: A new Survival map that will let you try your skills against the deadly rotating laser that you encountered in Trial 11: Run for Cover. This time, however, the enemies won’t give you a break!
[*]The Dungeon survival mode added: Another new survival map that uses all the mechanics from the fourth chamber of the campaign. This map will never get repetitive when you die hundreds of times, as the enemy spawning has been randomized!
[*]4 new achievements to earn by playing the survival modes
[*]Large optimization improvements. This will also help network play to be less laggy as the host computer no longer struggles to keep up :)
[list]
[*]Chamber 4 environment darkness optimized
[*]Blood machine blood optimized
		[*]Final boss FX optimized: Giant portals spell, Meteor Shower.
[/list]
	[*]Improved the design of the Final boss. Fixed a few exploit issues and balanced a few skills. Also fixed the fact that you could resurrect outside the arena.
[*]Inserted a startup logo screen to tell new players they should expect a hard game and should try to play it co-op :)
	[*]Improved a lot of localization, implementing translations for a lot of the things that were missing.
[/list]

Remember we always like to hear your opinions, so go give us some feedback on the forums!
Also a big thank you to the community members that helped us test this new patch for issues;
Rankaquion, Paurmon, Jedo, rialda_dreal and all the guys who volunteered but didn’t get to try it :)

Enjoy!
-BetaDwarf

notes.title: FORCED v1.22, Connecting people
notes.content:
[b]Hi![/b]

We have finally uploaded the massive network solution we've been working on for months. In short it replaces the old code we had and utilizes the steam backend, which should now allow more than 99% of people to connect to each other. 
Before that people might have been stuck in different router setups that we hadn't predicted, but that should no longer occur.

Minor bugs may have been introduced due to this massive update, but we haven't had any reports for days now, and we've been playing a lot as well. So we are pretty sure Forced should now offer you a great experience no matter what evil router from hell you might have in your dungeon. But if you encounter a bug please post it on the forum, we will check on a daily basis.

[b]Playing with randoms is awesome:[/b]
While playing recently, I encountered [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198107339610]Seolfer[/url] (rank 2 in single player), who didn't knew I was one of the developers. So I thought “I'm not gonna tell him that” and I still haven't... :) 
That lead to one of my best experiences with FORCED so far. We've been playing for hours and I was treated like a random internet guy from Denmark. Even without voice communication we were actually able to get the challenge crystals in world 4, amazing telekinetic play! :) 
It's quite a special experience to play a campaign driven game with a random player over the web. You share an intimate problem-solving time over several hours, and might never meet again. Well I just wanted to recommend grabbing a few crystals like that, instead of only using friends.
So if you meet Seolfer or similar awesomely behaving entities, you should definitely grab some trials with them :)

Lastly thanks for actively helping us fix the new network solution.

FORCED love!
[url=https://twitter.com/baboonlord]@Baboonlord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/betadwarf]@BetaDwarf[/url]

notes.title: FORCED v1.21, Network fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Sorry we've been out of touch for so long, we've been hard at work rewriting a lot of the new network code to fix all the problems it introduced.

Thank you again for your patience, and keep up the activity on the forums, it’s greatly helping us in figuring out how to improve the game!

-BetaDwarf

notes.title: FORCED patch 1.05 is live!
notes.content:
Patch 1.05 brings a number of fixes to issues the community has helped us track down, as well as aid to determine which hosts are viable connections when searching through the server list.

Here's the changelog:

[/h1]FORCED v1.05 changelog[/h1]
01/11/2013
[list]
[*]General
[list]
[*]Introduced a Second Life to singleplayer. The first time you die in a Trial you will be resurrected and invulnerable for a short time. This should bring the singleplayer experience more in line with how multiplayer works, that is, not an instant loss. If you use the second life, you will not be able to get the Challenge crystal from the Trial.
[*]Fixed an issue with the tutorial not progressing in the last room when playing in Swedish, Portugese, Spanish
[*]Fixed an issue with ability descriptions not appearing when right-clicked after having rebinded the right-click.
[*]Fixed an issue with some systems getting a black screen on startup when on a wireless connection.
[/list]




[*]Trials
[list]
[*]Trial 17: Fixed an issue with the challenge being impossible in multiplayer.
[/list]

[*]Achievements
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Volatile Omelet achievement not awarding correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Student of Pain achievement not awarding correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Hodor achievement not showing as completed in Steam.
[*]Fixed an issue with progress achievements not updating correctly.
[/list]

[*]Network
[list]
[*]Implemented connection status icon for the server list. This small indicator to the far right will show how well you can connect to a game, while the indicator at the top of the screen will show your ability to host. Green is good, yellow is some problems, red is bad and grey is unknown. This is an early version, and we know of an issue where some good connections will display as grey.
If you click on the details at the top of the screen you will get info about your status, which should help you find solutions to improve your ability to host.
[*]Fixed an issue with people not receiving a response from a drop-in server they had joined.
[*]Fixed an issue with people not returning to the main menu after a host disconnected.
[/list]

[*]Survival
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with Survival times from the Amphitheatre not being uploaded.
[/list]
[/list]

From here on we'll keep working on the network, as we're currently getting a lot of data that'll help us improve on the solution.

notes.title: Indie Co-op Arcade Game FORCED, Now Available
notes.content:
The co-op arcade action game, FORCED has come out of Early Access after a month of working closely with customer feedback, adding a variety of language support, and fine-tuning the gameplay.

Forced is described as a one- to four-player co-op arcade action RPG with puzzle and tactical elements. You are cast as slaves in the toughest fantasy gladiator school of them all, condemned to fight to the death, all the while attempting to win your freedom. You will face deadly trials and huge creatures, but Balfus, your Spirit Mentor will guide you in your quest to break the chains of oppression.

Coming out of Early Access doesn’t mean the developers intend to stop working on the game. In fact, the first thing you’ll see when launching the game is a list of all new features that the development steam still plans to add to the game over time.

Starting out as a small college team, the developers have been working on the game since 2010. You can follow their path in this illustrated visualization of the ups and downs of building and shipping a game as an indie team.

The game is available now on Steam, and features single-player, co-op, achievements, leaderboards, controller support, and Steam Trading Cards. Plus, save 20% when you buy during the first week of sales.

notes.title: New Mac and Linux Patch 0.05
notes.content:
FORCED Mac and Linux patch 0.05 Changelog 
08/10/2013 

General 
Player progression is now unified, meaning any crystals you gain carry over to other player modes (e.g. Getting 6 crystals in 1-player will mean you also have 6-crystals when playing 2-player) 
The Preparation Room has received a facelift. 
Improved game performance vastly, the game should now run much smoother on all systems.

Trials 
Tweaked a number of time trials including trial 9, 12 and 15. 
Fixed major bugs in Chamber 4. Everything should now be accessible and completable. 
Trial 25 is now available for play, have fun with the final boss. 
Introduced and tweaked Challenges for all remaining levels.

Network 
Fixed a number of issues preventing players from connecting to each other. 
Optimized network feel and load, we should see improved client-side gameplay experience as well as better hosting capacity for most people.
Survival mode 
New gameplay mode, created as a different type of game from the main menu. 
Play against hordes of enemies with a limited arsenal. The players to survive the longest will be legend!

Steam Integration 
Now saves player progression to the steam cloud - this unfortunatly means that we had to wipe all progression

Main menu & GUI 
Added leaderboards to trials, you can now compare your times to other gladiators. Show your worth! 
Main menu graphics reworked. 
Added profile system. It is now possible to create different profiles for your account. 
Improved usability to reflect drop-in functionality. A host can start the game and play while waiting for more players to join. 
Added kick player functionality for hosts. 
Fixed a number of issues with the settings menu. 
Fixed blurry UI on lower settings.
Enemies 
Added an ability and new graphics to Morgrul the Swarmer King. 
Added new graphics to the Elite Swarmers. 
Blood Carrier (formlery known as the heal swarmer) 
New graphics 
New stats to reflects it’s floaty nature.
Graw 
Upgraded graphics 
Fixed a number of graphical issues that obscured the mechanics.

Weapons 
Volcanic Hammer 
Core taunt: Added 25 healing to all allies in the radius.
Frost Shield 
New graphics for the Frost Shield, defend your allies and smite your 
enemies with the power of winter!

Audio 
Added new music tracks for bosses, different chambers and special levels. 
Added a number of new Balfus lines, especially later in the game.

Known issues 
You can’t quit the game with a controller.

notes.title: Winners of Intel Level Up Game Demo Contest Released
notes.content:
The nine category winners of the Intel Level Up Game Demo Contest are now available on Steam.

The winners are:
  • Perfection. - Game Of The Year and Best Puzzle/Physics Game

  • Lilly Looking Through - Best Adventure/Role Playing Game and Best Art Design

  • Assault Android Cactus - Best Action Game

  • Protocell - Best Platformer Game

  • Cube & Star: A Love Story - Best "Other" Game

  • TorqueL - Best Physics

  • BeatBlasters III - Best Sound

  • Life Goes On - Best Character Design

  • FORCED - Best 3D Graphics


Each of these demos, impressed the panel of indie developers and game-industry luminaries assembled by Intel and were selected from more than 90 entries into the contest.

In addition to all nine demos being available to download and play for free, three of the games are available to purchase and play right now, either as fully released or in Steam Early Access.

For more information and to download the free demos, see http://store.steampowered.com/sale/levelup

For contest details, please see: http://www.intel.com/software/levelup2013
